About Navira

Navira Global LLC — known everywhere simply as Navira — was founded in Kent, Washington, by a professional school-transport driver who has spent years behind the wheel on real morning and afternoon routes.

That experience shapes how we work. We know a missed pickup is not a small thing: it is a child waiting, a parent worried, and a school day disrupted. So Navira is organized around fast response — matching the right nearby driver to each trip quickly, communicating clearly, and following through until every student is home.

We work with student-transportation programs and school communities to cover regular daily routes, specialized transport, and urgent 'rescue' trips when a scheduled ride falls through. Our student transport serves Kent, Federal Way, Tacoma, and Auburn, Washington.

Drive With Navira

Driver registration is open for school transport drivers in Kent, Federal Way, Tacoma, and Auburn. Drive your own car on school-day mornings and afternoons, and make a real difference for local families. Here is what it takes — and how to start. You can register to drive here.

Driver requirements

  • Age 21 or older with a valid Washington driver’s license
  • Clean driving record — we review your driving abstract
  • Background check — every driver is screened before carrying students
  • Drug screening may be required under program rules
  • A reliable, insured vehicle — clean, safe, and well maintained, with working seat belts for every rider
  • Vehicle inspection completed before your first trip
  • A smartphone for trip details, navigation, and communication
  • The right temperament — patient, punctual, and kind with children

How it works

Register below

Fill in the short form on this page — just name, phone, city, and email. It takes under a minute and goes straight onto our driver list.

Talk with us

We contact you, explain how the work and pay operate, and answer your questions — no pressure and no obligation.

Complete your checks & training

Background check, driving record, vehicle inspection, and Navira’s free online safety training.

Start receiving trips

We match you with regular routes and rescue trips near your home that fit your availability.

Free for every Navira driver

Navira Driver Safety Training

Before a Navira driver carries a single student, they complete our own training course — free of charge — covering the rules and judgment that keep students safe on every trip.

It is one of the strongest reasons drivers join Navira, and one of the strongest reasons schools and programs trust us: our drivers are prepared, not just licensed.

Snoqualmie Valley's Electric School Buses Can Now Give Power Back to the Grid

On Wednesday, November 18, Snoqualmie Valley School District cut the ribbon on a new Vehicle-to-Grid charging station at its Transportation Center — a charger that not only powers its electric school buses, but lets the buses send electricity back to the grid when they are not carrying students. The project is a partnership with Puget Sound Energy and the Washington State Department of Commerce, which together invested more than $1.2 million in four of these charging stations across two Washington school districts. Fourth-grade students from Snoqualmie Elementary even rode an electric school bus to the ceremony, to see the science they are learning in class at work in their own community. At Navira, we believe every student deserves a clean, calm ride to school — and we love seeing Washington districts lead the way. Our Story: From Driver to Company

Navira Global LLC started with one driver: Hussam Idris. Hussam came to Washington from Sudan. His family are refugees in Cairo, and he supports them. For years, Hussam drove students to school in Washington — first as a rideshare driver, then as an EverDriven driver on school runs in Federal Way. He saw how much families and schools depend on safe, on-time transport, and he saw drivers who needed fair pay and clear rules. In October 2026 he started his own company, Navira Global LLC, a registered Washington LLC, and on November 6, 2026, our Business License was issued. Our mission is simple: every student arrives safe and on time, and every driver is treated fairly and paid on time. We are now building our team of drivers in the Tacoma area, and our strength is Quick Match — matching trips fast to available drivers, especially same-day rescue trips.

November 2026

How School Transportation Works in Washington

In Washington, students who live far from school, or who need extra help getting there, travel by school transport instead of the family car. Schools and districts arrange the rides, and local transportation providers and their drivers carry them out — morning pick-up at home, drop-off at school, and the return trip in the afternoon. Every driver who carries students must pass a background check first, and the vehicles must be safe and reliable. At Navira, we do daily school runs, specialized transport, and rescue and cover trips when a regular driver cannot make it. We serve Kent, Federal Way, Tacoma, and Auburn. If your school or district needs a ride for a student, write to us at info@naviragloballlc.com.

November 2026

How We Train Our Drivers

Before any Navira driver carries a student, three things happen. First, the driver completes our free Driver Safety Training — a short course with the rules and guidance for transporting students safely. Second, the driver passes a background check. Third, the driver follows our 15-item onboarding checklist, and signs an acknowledgment that they read and understood the training. Safety comes first, every time. If you want to drive with Navira, register on our website and we will call you.

Common Questions

Plain answers about Navira, driving with us, and the areas we serve. Ready to join? Go to driver registration.

What does Navira do?

Navira provides school transportation and student transport in Washington. We drive students to school in the morning and home in the afternoon on regular daily routes. We also cover rescue trips when a planned ride falls through, and individual door-to-door transport for students who need extra care.

Who can drive for Navira?

Adults age 21 or older who live in or near Kent, Federal Way, Tacoma, or Auburn, hold a valid Washington driver’s license, have a clean driving record, and are patient and kind with children. If that sounds like you, complete the driver registration form and we will contact you.

What do drivers need?

You need a valid Washington driver’s license, a background check, a driving record review, and a reliable, insured vehicle that is clean and well kept, with working seat belts for every rider. Your vehicle must pass an inspection before your first trip. You also need a smartphone for trip details and directions. Drug screening may be required under program rules.

Which areas does Navira serve?

Navira is based in Kent, Washington. We provide school transportation and student transport in Kent, Federal Way, Tacoma, and Auburn, Washington.

Does Navira offer wheelchair-accessible transport?

Coming soon — not available now. Wheelchair-accessible transport is a planned part of Navira’s growth, so students who use wheelchairs will get the same reliable, respectful service as everyone else. We will update this page when it is ready.

Is driver training free?

Yes. Driver training is free. Every Navira driver completes our student safety training course at no cost before carrying students. The course covers safe pickup and drop-off, seat belts and child restraints, working with special-needs students, and what to do in an emergency. Register to drive to get started.
